tenderly.notes: few large requests; OR-arrays fail around ~1000; dense windows fail deterministically (HTTP 400 / result cap ~20k logs) -> bisect, never fall back

drpc.notes: free plan answers HTTP 400 ("ranges over 10000 blocks are not supported on free plan") for eth_getLogs windows > ~100 blocks (measured 2026-10-15); no JSON-RPC batching

mevblocker.notes: eth_call rate-limited after ~100 calls; the 50,000-block cap is measured for single-address filtered getLogs only (tribunal 2026-10); multi-address and topic-only shapes are unmeasured, so lib.rpc.shape_cap() gives them the conservative unmeasured_shape_cap
